items.name: narration_hi
items.direction: Narrate this as a high-energy 'what if' geography Short for BHUGOL, a popular geography fun-facts YouTube channel, in natural spoken Hindi like a top Indian geography explainer channel. The Narrator is SUPER excited, practically bursting with energy: a hyped-up, thrilled YouTube host who can't believe how cool this story is and can't wait to tell you. Huge smile in the voice the whole way, bright and punchy, loud-ish and lively. Wide, dramatic pitch movement: rise with real wonder on every question, hit every number with genuine amazement ('WOW' energy), build excitement through each line, and land each punchline with a grin after a tiny comic pause. 'Twist ये है' gets a playful, knowing, excited lift. 'लेकिन ये अभी सबसे अजीब बात नहीं है' is whispered-excited, leaning in like a secret. 'बात आगे नहीं बढ़ी।' and 'पैसा आज तक नहीं आया।' are deadpan and funny. Numbers and English words (place names, city, metro area, million, billion, dollar, economy, capital, miles, twist, vote, state, war, declare, surrender, one minute) are spoken in English, naturally, the way Indian creators mix them. The last line trails off unfinished on 'क्योंकि सच बताऊं...', voice staying up, so it loops straight back into the first line. Pace is quick and bouncy with short crisp pauses; never slow, flat, calm, sleepy, bored or documentary-serious. VOICE IDENTITY: always the same warm baritone host, same person and same high energy level throughout. Say GTA as the letters G-T-A. Pronounce 'Tallahassee' as 'tal-uh-HASS-ee' and 'Conch' as 'konk' (rhymes with 'honk'). Read ONLY the text provided, word for word, every line in order; never add words of your own.
lines: अगर Vice City... एक अलग देश बन जाए?
G-T-A six में ये एक city है। असल ज़िंदगी में... ये Miami है।
और Miami metro area में रहते हैं six million से ज़्यादा लोग।
तो इस देश को क्या मिलेगा?
Five hundred billion dollar से बड़ी economy...
और capital आख़िरकार पास होगी। Tallahassee तो four hundred miles से ज़्यादा दूर है।
लेकिन twist ये है: ये कोशिश हो चुकी है।
Twenty fourteen में South Miami city ने vote किया... three two...
Florida को दो हिस्सों में बांटकर बनाने के लिए fifty-first state.
लेकिन ये अभी सबसे अजीब बात नहीं है।
Nineteen eighty-two में Key West सच में अलग हो गया... नाम रखा Conch Republic.
उसने America पर war declare किया...
one minute बाद surrender कर दिया...
और मांगी one billion dollar की मदद।
तो... Vice City या Florida? क्योंकि सच बताऊं...
